records.sql:
SELECT SUM(approved_amount) AS total_approved_loan_amount
FROM loans
WHERE contract_status = 'finished'
  AND payment_status = 'fully_paid'
  AND has_problems = 0;

SELECT AVG(monthly_payment) AS avg_monthly_payment
FROM loans;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_clients
FROM clients
WHERE gender = 'F'
  AND district_id IN (
      SELECT district_id
      FROM districts
      GROUP BY district_id
      HAVING AVG(salary) > 10000
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_clients
FROM clients c
JOIN accounts a ON c.client_id = a.account_owner_id
JOIN regions r ON a.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE r.region_name = 'Prague';

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM transactions
WHERE account_id = 1
  AND transaction_date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31';

SELECT
    d.district_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT disp.client_id) AS owner_count
FROM district d
JOIN account a
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp
    ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.region = 'south Moravia'
GROUP BY d.district_name
ORDER BY owner_count DESC;

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    SUM(a.loan_amount) AS total_loan_amount
FROM clients c
JOIN accounts a
    ON a.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE a.status = 'account owner'
GROUP BY
    c.client_id,
    c.gender
ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan.loan_id) AS running_loans_good_standing
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE loan.status IN ('A', 'C')          -- running contracts (A = OK, C = in arrears but still running)
  AND loan.status = 'A'                  -- good standing
  AND client.gender = 'M'
  AND district.region = 'North Bohemia';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM loan WHERE status = 'A'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS owner_count FROM "disp" WHERE type = 'OWNER'
SELECT AVG(payments) AS avg_monthly_payment FROM loan
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_clients FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND CAST(d.A11 AS INTEGER) > 10000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) FROM disp d JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND di.A3 = 'Prague'
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM trans WHERE account_id = 1 AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1997'

SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) AS owner_count FROM disp dp JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER' AND d.A3 = 'south Moravia' GROUP BY d.A2 ORDER BY owner_count DESC

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS owners
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp p ON p.client_id = c.client_id AND p.type = 'OWNER'
WHERE d.A3 = 'south Moravia'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY owners DESC

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender
ORDER BY total_loan DESC
LIMIT 5
